subject: TESTLESS classification overrides real coverage-context and test-file evidence
evidence: Context-covered modules with tracked tests were labelled TESTLESS.
proposal: Derive TESTLESS from static attribution plus executed context evidence.

subject: latent-bug route stops at red-on-pristine without filing or recording the defect
evidence: The same-basename regression was found but the dry-run had no explicit filing transition.
proposal: Require a filed reference or an explicit outward-action blocker.

subject: TESTLESS classification overrides real coverage-context and test-file evidence
evidence: The contradictory labels recurred with the same context input.
proposal: Derive TESTLESS from static attribution plus executed context evidence.

subject: growth-adhoc restoration depends on writable Git index and can leave the CUT mutated
evidence: A worktree index-lock failure left the temporary source mutant behind.
proposal: Snapshot and restore exact bytes without Git.

subject: TESTLESS classification overrides real coverage-context and test-file evidence
evidence: The contradictory labels recurred for a third run.
proposal: Derive TESTLESS from static attribution plus executed context evidence.

subject: growth-adhoc restoration depends on writable Git index and can leave the CUT mutated
evidence: The next run still needed extra Git-index permission for restoration.
proposal: Snapshot and restore exact bytes without Git.

evidence: Context schema v2 carries test nodeids into TESTLESS classification; Grow and Sharpen temporary edits restore verified exact bytes.
Contracts v4/v3, fail-closed JSON and coverage runners, target-grounded many-to-many attribution, preservation witness, and campaign readiness are covered by loop-tools-test.

subject: scenario-gate composition diverges across contract surfaces and is not enforced by the harness
evidence: Growth-adhoc passed while context-delta structurally bounced. SPEC and harness accept growth OR context, but ADAPTERS, PROMPTS, and Codex skill wording imply every scenario arm must pass; the smoke fixture sets both proofs true and does not cover this branch.
proposal: Compute disposition from structured fields, synchronize every contract surface to the OR rule, and add growth-only, context-only, and neither smoke cases with arms_run consistency.

subject: coverage-context evidence omits per-line coordinates required by scenario-map subtraction
evidence: The selected controller artifact exposed under_spec=700 and 195 nodeids but no weak or uncovered line coordinates, forcing manual code/test inspection and ad-hoc JSON projections.
proposal: Add uncovered and weak line-to-nodeid coordinates plus a module-filtered explain command.

subject: repowise steering lacks a fail-closed freshness and completion check
evidence: After repowise update, MCP initially reported the old indexed commit. A later retry retrieved the exact live method at the current SHA, but synthesis exceeded its 60-second budget and returned an empty low-confidence answer with an oversized fallback payload.
proposal: Require indexed SHA to equal worktree HEAD and a completed answer before Repowise can affect selection; otherwise use bounded raw retrieval and record synthesis unavailable.

subject: red-on-pristine classification is delegated to an author environment that may not be execution-ready
evidence: The isolated author could not collect the test because fontTools was missing while the root environment ran it green.
proposal: Have the root adapter run and classify pristine tests; authors report environment failures separately.

subject: test-mislevelled-realio conflates external I/O with bounded sleep polling
evidence: Sharpen selected an in-process thread-lifecycle test because time.sleep was counted as actionable real I/O even though no subprocess, socket, or display boundary was crossed.
proposal: Split actionable external-I/O findings from an advisory sleep-polling smell and exclude the latter from actionable triage scoring.

subject: the brittleness axis cannot detect synchronization coupled to a helper call route
evidence: An Event wrapped around tooltip.panel_cache_setdefault passed target, mapped, lint, anti-cheat, and preservation gates, but a behavior-preserving inline of the helper made the test time out.
proposal: Add a certified inline-trivial-wrapper transform, validate it with frozen-baseline A/B, and bump toolset_version only after demonstrated yield.

subject: public function visibility was mistaken for an observable synchronization seam
evidence: The candidate synchronized on a public module helper whose invocation was not contractual; the semantic cache-membership oracle was unchanged.
proposal: Require synchronization to observe test-owned state or output unless the production call itself is the contract.

subject: witness proposals are not preflighted against the target test execution path
evidence: The first attempt mutated an unused controller delegator and spent a full retry before preservation correctly bounced it.
proposal: Require the mutated function to be on the target test path and require the pristine old test to kill the witness before the full gate.

subject: role environments and author-side test attempts add latency without authoritative evidence
evidence: The author environment lacked a dependency while the root environment passed the test; role invocations dominated elapsed time and needed nudges.
proposal: Give roles an exact worktree contract and bounded deadline, prohibit author-side gate execution, and have the orchestrator test returned diffs immediately.
